error.message: verification command failed with exit code 2: python scripts/aios_full_suite_contention_diagnostic.py

instructions: Continue only from canonical failed RUN-233-001 and exact clean transportable candidate 0a1cb5dddb3395b4094ab03f7de209a3d6b3aed3. Preserve the FAILURE, TASK-233 semantics, the already-added diagnostic architecture, and all implementation compatible with the repair. Do not restart PRIMARY from main, create a new TASK id/revision, or discard the failed candidate.

Canonical Runtime verification passed the implementation-local regression suite (15 passed) but the real command 'python scripts/aios_full_suite_contention_diagnostic.py' exited 2 with diagnostic integrity failure before meaningful full-n12 observation. Human bounded collection-only diagnosis on the exact failed candidate showed COLLECTION_EXIT=0, TOTAL_NODEIDS=2447, INVALID_NODEIDS=274 and the exact DiagnosticError 'unsafe nodeid content'. The rejected valid pytest-generated nodeids include parameter IDs containing slash characters, quote characters, URL-like colon-slash sequences and double-dot data. Treat this Human output as diagnostic planning evidence only, not canonical Runtime verification.

Correct the nodeid identity model rather than extending the existing character allowlist piecemeal. A pytest nodeid has two semantic regions: the repository test-file path before the first '::', and pytest-owned selector/parameter data after it. Continue to validate the file-path region strictly as a bounded repo-relative tests/...py path with no traversal, absolute path, backslash ambiguity, NUL or control characters. Do not interpret '/', '..', ':/' or quoting inside pytest parameter/selector data as filesystem traversal.

Preserve exact replay semantics without creating a privacy regression. Raw pytest-generated selectors may exist only as bounded transient execution data needed to select the exact failed tests inside the diagnostic temporary workspace/process lifetime. They must not be printed by the command, included in the final JSON observation when their selector/parameter portion contains arbitrary data, copied into Runtime EVIDENCE summaries, or otherwise become a durable diagnostic payload.

Persist a deterministic one-to-one safe identity for each collected/executed/failed selector: retain only the validated repo-local test path plus bounded structural test identity that is safe to expose, and bind the complete original pytest nodeid by SHA-256 fingerprint. Parameterized selectors containing arbitrary values, URLs, quotes, path-like text or other data must be represented by the safe identity/fingerprint rather than raw parameter text. Distinct raw nodeids must remain distinguishable; collision, duplicate mapping, malformed fingerprint or ambiguous identity must fail closed.

Keep the raw-to-safe mapping exact and internal so Phase 2 serial replay and Phase 3 n4 replay still execute exactly the raw failed selector set discovered by the one full-n12 phase. The final reported full_n12_failed_nodeids/serial_reproduced_nodeids/n4_reproduced_nodeids, or a schema-compatible safe replacement inside the three-file repair, must expose deterministic safe identities that preserve exact set membership and equality without leaking raw parameter values.

Preserve TASK-233's bounded experiment exactly: one canonical collection, at most one full-suite n12 execution, then only if bounded failures exist exactly one serial and one n4 replay of that same failure set; hard maximum 64 unique failures; no retry, no fallback, no worker selection, no remediation choice, and diagnostic experiment success remains distinct from observed pytest pass/fail.

Preserve all existing subject-stability, collection/execution identity, distinct-process, pytest temporary-root, process-local Git fixture cache-root, typed cause, over-bound, malformed-observation and unsafe-path fail-closed checks. Do not weaken source_locus validation or path sanitization for actual filesystem fields merely to admit pytest parameter data.

Strengthen regression coverage with realistic pytest nodeids that contain at least slash data, quotes, URL-like 'scheme://...' data, double-dot parameter data and another character previously rejected by the old allowlist. Prove these are accepted as selector data, replayed exactly, represented by stable safe identities/fingerprints, and absent raw from final durable JSON. Also prove an absolute/traversing test-file path, NUL/control characters, ambiguous safe-identity mapping and tampered fingerprint still fail closed.

Do not modify production Runtime/Operator, TASK-231, TASK-233, roadmap, selected worker policy, existing BP-V4 files, Defender configuration, workflows/carriers, Reviewer/Publisher semantics, or any file outside the three-file modification scope.

Runtime owns verification and must rerun the exact TASK-233 verification contract: 'python -m pytest -q tests/test_aios_full_suite_contention_diagnostic.py'; 'python scripts/aios_full_suite_contention_diagnostic.py'; 'git diff --check'. Executor must not claim Runtime PASS, review, publication, worker adoption, Defender causality or roadmap advancement.

acceptance.condition: Repository contains the fixed no-argument full-suite contention diagnostic and a dedicated structured pytest observer without modifying existing production or selected-verification behavior.

The diagnostic performs at most one full-suite n12 execution and, only after bounded failure discovery, exactly one serial and one n4 replay of the same failed-nodeid set, with no retry/fallback or worker-selection behavior.
Failure capture is complete up to the hard 64-identity bound, typed, deterministic and sanitized, and fails closed for over-bound, malformed, unsafe, duplicate or inconsistent observations.
Exact-subject stability, collection/execution identity and per-profile mutable root isolation are enforced across collection, full-n12, serial replay and n4 replay.

The final observation exposes full-n12 failures, serial reproductions, n4 reproductions and only the allowed mechanical classification without attributing cause to Defender, choosing a worker count, or prescribing a remediation.

Regression tests cover full-n12 pass, full-suite-context-dependent failure, serial-reproducible failure, n4-parallel-reproducible failure, mixed outcome, 64-bound enforcement, unsafe cause rejection, exact replay identity and subject-change failure.

assumptions: Canonical main at authoring is edd7543b8fbd1f6fd41e02c04cd8f7f395e6f10b.
RUN-231-003 is a canonical FAILURE for TASK-231 r2 at phase VERIFICATION with failure artifact 694a02c4acb4ab865df7df928e5590af3f5b1203 and failed candidate fa9d87df08e0346fff4a13d8dc891d3ed0480104.

RUN-231-003 observed workers=12, distribution=load, max_worker_restart=0, collection count 2435, pytest elapsed 362.322714s, reported failure count 36, and all selected-wrapper conformance facts true.
The current selected-wrapper diagnostic limit of 20 identities is an intentional bounded transport surface and must not be globally expanded merely for this investigation.

Human observed Windows Defender activity during an n12 run. That is a noncanonical host-level hypothesis only. TASK-233 must neither claim Defender causality nor change Defender configuration, exclusions, PATH, host security policy, or machine-wide settings.
Human selection of workers=12 remains planning state. TASK-233 is diagnostic only and cannot adopt, reject, rank, or automatically change the selected worker profile.
Runtime owns canonical execution/verification evidence. Diagnostic observations are engineering evidence about the experiment, not a Reviewer verdict or automatic remediation decision.

hard: Add one fixed no-argument diagnostic command: 'python scripts/aios_full_suite_contention_diagnostic.py'. It must reject positional/options input before test execution.
The diagnostic must require a clean exact Git commit and preserve the same subject SHA before and after every phase. Any subject mutation fails closed.

Phase 1 must perform exactly one canonical collection followed by exactly one full-suite workers=12 execution using distribution=load and max_worker_restart=0. No second full-suite execution is permitted.

The full-suite observer must retain every unique failure identity up to a hard maximum of 64 identities. If more than 64 unique failures are observed, the diagnostic fails closed as over-bound rather than truncating silently.

Failure observations must be structured and bounded: normalized nodeid, pytest phase, worker/controller identity where applicable, exception type, stable message fingerprint, and only sanitized typed cause fields such as errno/winerror, Git diagnostic category, return code, or repository-test source locus. Raw exception messages, raw stderr/stdout and unsanitized absolute paths are forbidden.

If the full-suite workers=12 phase reports zero failures and exits successfully, the diagnostic must stop without replay phases and report a deterministic FULL_N12_PASS observation. It must not reinterpret that single observation as TASK-231 success or worker-policy adoption.

If the full-suite workers=12 phase reports one through 64 unique failed nodeids, Phase 2 must replay exactly that discovered nodeid set once serially and Phase 3 must replay exactly the same nodeid set once at workers=4 with distribution=load and max_worker_restart=0. No additional nodeids, retries, randomization, fallback profiles or data-dependent correction actions are allowed.

Each replay phase must use its own isolated pytest temporary root and process-local Git fixture cache roots and must verify that the exact requested nodeid set was collected/executed once without duplicate or missing identities.

The final JSON observation must mechanically expose, without remediation recommendation, the exact full-n12 failed nodeid set and the subsets that reproduce in serial and workers=4. A deterministic classification may use only these names: FULL_N12_PASS, SERIAL_REPRODUCIBLE, N4_PARALLEL_REPRODUCIBLE, FULL_SUITE_CONTEXT_DEPENDENT, or MIXED.

Classification semantics are observational only: FULL_N12_PASS means the one full-n12 phase passed; SERIAL_REPRODUCIBLE means every full-n12 failed node also fails in isolated serial replay; N4_PARALLEL_REPRODUCIBLE means no node fails serially and at least one fails in isolated n4 replay; FULL_SUITE_CONTEXT_DEPENDENT means all full-n12 failed nodes pass both isolated serial and isolated n4 replay; MIXED covers all other bounded combinations.

The command must exit zero when the diagnostic experiment itself completed faithfully, even when observed pytest phases contain test failures; malformed, over-bound, inconsistent, incomplete, unsafe or subject-mutating observations must exit nonzero.
Existing selected-profile and BP-V4 behavior must remain byte-for-byte untouched outside the three new files. No file outside scope.modify may change.

task.goal: Add one bounded, observational full-suite parallel-contention diagnostic that reproduces the RUN-231-003 failure surface without changing production semantics or selected worker policy. The diagnostic must run one exact-subject full-suite workers=12 observation, retain the complete bounded failure identity set and typed/sanitized cause facts, then replay only those exact failed nodeids once serially and once at workers=4 so Brain/Human can distinguish intrinsic correctness failures, broad parallel sensitivity, and failures that appear only in full-suite context before TASK-231 is resumed.
non_goals: Modify production Runtime, Operator, publication/review lifecycle, frozen Kernel semantics, selected verification profile, TASK-231 implementation, pytest/xdist versions, or worker-count policy.

Change scripts/aios_parallel_full_suite.py, src/aios_renew/parallel_verification.py, tests/bp_v4_probe_plugin.py, historical BP-V4 diagnostic grammar, or the selected-wrapper 20-identity transport bound.
Run a workers 4/8/12/16 selection matrix, benchmark worker candidates, select or recommend another worker count, or automatically mutate roadmap state.
Retry the full suite, fall back from workers=12, suppress/skip/xfail tests, inflate timeouts, or automatically repair any observed failure.
Disable Microsoft Defender, add Defender exclusions, change antivirus policy, alter PATH/Git executable selection, or make any host-wide security/performance mutation.
Persist raw pytest stdout/stderr, secrets, absolute private paths, complete exception messages, credentials, URLs, or unbounded failure payloads.
Push or publish from Executor implementation.
task.problem: TASK-232 fixed two confirmed test-infrastructure defects and published at 7f91c19b5a0035b9c1eef3a284e6bd7c0b4364d5. TASK-231 r2 was then rerun as RUN-231-003 from current planning main and again failed Runtime verification at workers=12 with 36 pytest failures. All selected-wrapper conformance facts remained true, but the current selected-wrapper failure diagnostic deliberately reports only the deterministic lowest 20 failure identities and discards pytest stdout/stderr. Therefore canonical evidence does not expose the complete failure population or typed failure causes needed to decide whether the remaining issue is intrinsic correctness, general parallel sensitivity, full-suite interaction, or host/resource contention. Re-running TASK-231 blindly would duplicate cost without resolving this uncertainty.
